def main():
    s = input().strip()
    run_lengths = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        start = i
        current = s[i]
        while i < n and s[i] == current:
            i += 1
        run_lengths.append(i - start)
    ans = sum(1 for length in run_lengths if length % 2 == 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
